'''Rordak''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Rordak system/Legends|Rordak system]],<ref name="PoG1" /> located in the [[Pelgrin sector/Legends|Pelgrin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was originally [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but millions of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it expanded to form a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]], destroying the three innermost planets and leaving only [[Rordak]], the desolate and mountainous [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Viska (species)|Viska]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="PoG1" />
